title: Paid time off
text: Full-time employees at fictional Cedar Works receive 15 days (120 hours) of PTO per year. Your current balance comes from the HR ledger, not this handbook. Submit a request with a start date, end date, and leave category. Weekdays count as eight hours; weekends do not count. This demo does not maintain a holiday calendar. A People reviewer approves or declines requests. Pending PTO requests reserve hours. Requests longer than five working days or exceeding the available balance are escalated for individual review.

title: Parental leave
text: Eligible full-time employees may request 12 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment. Contact People Operations at least 30 days before the anticipated start when possible. People Operations determines eligibility and coordinates dates privately. The assistant can explain this fictional policy and open a review request; it cannot decide eligibility or request medical records.

title: Private or sensitive concerns
text: Medical leave, accommodations, harassment, discrimination, pay disputes, and employment decisions must go to a People specialist. Do not include diagnoses, medical records, or details of a complaint in this demo. The assistant cannot make legal, medical, compensation, or employment decisions.

title: New employee onboarding
text: On your first day, complete your profile in the HR portal, confirm your equipment with IT, and meet your manager. By the end of week one, complete security training and review the handbook. If an account or device is missing, contact the IT help desk. People Operations owns the onboarding checklist.

title: Remote work and equipment
text: Employees may work remotely within their approved work location. A change of state or country needs People and IT review before travel. Standard equipment includes a company laptop and headset. Submit an IT request for equipment problems; do not share passwords with the assistant.
